inference_boundary: Five seed labels quantify conditional training or algorithmic variation on one fixed address subset, fold assignment and graph snapshot.
reporting_rule: Report means, across-seed standard deviations, ranges and direction fractions. Do not use seed-level t intervals or p-values as population inference.
multiple_testing_rule: GNN seed-level p-values are diagnostic and excluded from confirmatory claims; no significance family is asserted and no multiplicity correction is required.
xgboost_note: Both XGBoost conditions have one unique score across five requested seeds; those labels do not constitute repeated XGBoost realisations here.
permitted_interpretation: Conditional stability on the fixed 153-address balanced subset.
Directional consistency across five requested training-seed labels.
Descriptive comparison of the frozen model configurations.
prohibited_interpretation: Uncertainty over new addresses, entities, graph snapshots or time periods.
Five independent datasets or five independent address samples.
